tasks.subject: Task 0: Project scaffold + requirements
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create directory tree, pinned requirements.txt, package inits, conftest.py; confirm venv installs.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["requirements.txt", "src/__init__.py", "conftest.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -c \"import src\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["pip install succeeds", "import src works"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Dukascopy data fetcher
tasks.description:
**Goal:** fetch_ohlc() downloads XAUUSD candles from Dukascopy, caches to parquet; cache hit avoids network.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/data_fetcher.py", "tests/test_data_fetcher.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/pytest tests/test_data_fetcher.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["returns contract columns", "cache hit avoids download", "bad timeframe/dates raise"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Data loader (validate/slice/resample)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** load_ohlc() normalizes/validates OHLC to UTC-indexed frame; resample() builds higher TF.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/data_loader.py", "tests/test_data_loader.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/pytest tests/test_data_loader.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["accepts CSV path and DataFrame", "rejects bad OHLC/NaN/naive-tz", "resample right-labeled drops gaps"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Strategy interface (Order/Position/Context/Strategy)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Plug-in contract: dataclasses + Context recording order intents + Strategy base with params schema.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/strategy.py", "tests/test_strategy.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/pytest tests/test_strategy.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["enter records Order, close sets flag", "bar/history correct", "size_for_risk math", "param merge"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Engine + correctness tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Bar-by-bar engine: next-bar-open fills, costs, intrabar bracket resolution, gap-through, equity/balance; hand-computed tests.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/engine.py", "tests/test_engine.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/pytest tests/test_engine.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no look-ahead next-open", "long/short pnl with costs", "intrabar stop_first vs tp_first", "gap-through at open", "equity vs balance", "equity<=0 stops"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Metrics
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure compute_metrics(result) -> (dict, summary_df); PF, R, drawdown, sharpe/sortino, exposure; divide-by-zero guards.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/metrics.py", "tests/test_metrics.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/pytest tests/test_metrics.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["PF/win-rate/expectancy correct", "max drawdown abs+pct+duration", "no_trades flag + PF inf", "returns dict + df"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Runner + MA crossover + auto-discovery + CLI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** runner.run_backtest (builds HTF + delegates), MACrossover strategy, auto-discovery registry, headless CLI.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/runner.py", "src/strategies/ma_crossover.py", "src/strategies/__init__.py", "run_cli.py", "tests/test_runner.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/pytest tests/test_runner.py -v && .venv/bin/python run_cli.py --synthetic", "acceptanceCriteria": ["registry discovers MACrossover", "runner builds HTF", "MACrossover >=1 trade", "CLI prints metrics"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Streamlit UI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Thin UI: data source + date range + dynamic params + costs -> run_backtest -> cards, equity/drawdown chart, R histogram, trade log CSV.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python -c \"import ast; ast.parse(open('app.py').read()); print('ok')\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["parses/compiles", "sidebar data+params+costs+run", "main cards+charts+trade log"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: SMC template + README
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Documented non-functional smc_template.py (HTF/session/structural stop stubs) + README (data, fetch, add-strategy, engine assumptions, run).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/strategies/smc_template.py", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/pytest -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["template with TODOs doesn't trade", "appears in registry", "full suite passes", "README documents assumptions"]}
```
